background.text: 重复检索会反复编码没有变化的文档布局，造成多余计算。

evidence.quote: Document retrieval repeatedly encodes unchanged layouts.

direction.text: 面向重复查询和局部编辑的文档检索加速。

evidence.quote: Our question is whether reusing layout features can reduce repeated-search latency without reducing retrieval quality.

problem.text: 怎样降低重复检索延迟，同时保留检索质量和小字细节？

evidence.quote: Document retrieval repeatedly encodes unchanged layouts. LiteScan [1] reduces image resolution, but loses small-text details. Our question is whether reusing layout features can reduce repeated-search latency without reducing retrieval quality.

approach.text: 先保存能复用的布局特征，后续只重算被编辑的区域。

evidence.quote: ToyIndex builds a page-layout cache once. When a document changes, a region hash selects changed regions for re-encoding; the retriever combines refreshed regions with cached features.

methods.text: 首次建立页面布局缓存；文档发生改动时，用区域哈希定位变化，重编码这些区域，再把新特征与缓存特征一起用于检索。

evidence.quote: ToyIndex builds a page-layout cache once. When a document changes, a region hash selects changed regions for re-encoding; the retriever combines refreshed regions with cached features.

summary.text: 该方法用增量更新减少重复计算；在所给 MiniDocs 测试中，ToyIndex 的 Recall@10 为 92.0%、查询延迟为 12 ms。结果只覆盖所给设备和测试条件，延迟不含建缓存。

evidence.quote: ToyIndex builds a page-layout cache once. When a document changes, a region hash selects changed regions for re-encoding; the retriever combines refreshed regions with cached features. On synthetic MiniDocs v1 test, using one ExampleGPU, batch size 1 and FP16, ToyIndex reaches Recall@10 92.0% with query latency 12 ms; LiteScan reaches Recall@10 89.0% with query latency 20 ms. Latency excludes initial cache construction.

problem_signatures.objective: 降低重复文档检索延迟并维持检索质量
problem_signatures.input: 未变化或局部编辑的文档与检索查询
problem_signatures.bottleneck: 重复编码未变化的布局
constraints: 大幅重排页面需要重建缓存

evidence.quote: Document retrieval repeatedly encodes unchanged layouts. LiteScan [1] reduces image resolution, but loses small-text details. Our question is whether reusing layout features can reduce repeated-search latency without reducing retrieval quality.
ToyIndex builds a page-layout cache once. When a document changes, a region hash selects changed regions for re-encoding; the retriever combines refreshed regions with cached features.
The cache assumes stable layout coordinates; large page rearrangements require rebuilding it.

results.text: 同一 ExampleGPU、batch size 1、FP16、MiniDocs v1 test 条件下：ToyIndex Recall@10 92.0%、延迟 12 ms；LiteScan 为 89.0% 和 20 ms。延迟不含首次缓存构建。

evidence.quote: MiniDocs v1 test, using one ExampleGPU, batch size 1 and FP16, ToyIndex reaches Recall@10 92.0% with query latency 12 ms; LiteScan reaches Recall@10 89.0% with query latency 20 ms. Latency excludes initial cache construction.

reported_limitations.text: 缓存依赖稳定布局坐标，大规模页面重排需要重建；论文没有报告货币成本。

evidence.quote: The cache assumes stable layout coordinates; large page rearrangements require rebuilding it. Monetary cost is not reported.

limitations: 这是 synthetic fixture，不是真实论文；实验结果只支持样例给出的设置。
